controls.rationale: Server-side encryption ensures data at rest is protected.
Public access block prevents unauthorized public read/write.
Explicit block on public ACLs and policies limits exposure.
Restricting public access enforces a security boundary on the bucket.
IAM role defines a managed identity subject to account management controls.
IAM role policy enforces least-privilege access to AWS resources.
Role-based access limits permissions to those required for function.
KMS key provides managed cryptographic key lifecycle.
KMS-managed encryption key protects data at rest.
Automatic key rotation reduces risk of key compromise over time.
storage_encrypted=true encrypts the RDS volume at rest.
Automated backups with non-zero retention period satisfy backup requirements.
35-day retention satisfies FedRAMP audit log retention guidance.
Multi-AZ deployment provides high availability and failover.
Multi-AZ protects database availability against zone failures.
CloudTrail records API-level audit events across the account.
CloudTrail captures who, what, when, where for every API call.
CloudTrail generates audit records for all supported AWS services.
Log file validation detects tampering with delivered log files.
Global service events provides complete audit coverage.
Multi-region trail ensures audit coverage in all active regions.

remediations.risk_explanation: Unscanned systems accumulate exploitable vulnerabilities. FedRAMP RA-5 requires regular vulnerability scanning with findings tracked and remediated within defined timeframes (30 days for critical/high).
remediations.remediation_action: Enable Amazon Inspector v2 for EC2 and container image scanning. Enable AWS Security Hub to aggregate findings. Configure SNS alerts for critical findings.

remediations.risk_explanation: Unencrypted data in transit can be intercepted and read by an adversary performing a man-in-the-middle attack. FedRAMP SC-8 requires encryption of all data in transit using TLS 1.2 or higher.
remediations.remediation_action: Enforce HTTPS on all load balancers and APIs. Add an aws_lb_listener with protocol=HTTPS and a valid ACM certificate. Add an aws_api_gateway_domain_name with a security policy of TLS_1_2.

remediations.risk_explanation: Without continuous monitoring, attacks can persist undetected for extended periods. FedRAMP SI-4 requires that the information system is monitored for attacks and indicators of potential attacks.
remediations.remediation_action: Enable Amazon GuardDuty in all regions. Configure EventBridge rules to route HIGH/CRITICAL findings to SNS for alerting.
